SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: KUANDIKA 6.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI METHALI

This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

PART 1: Explain what Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

Do one short practice that proves you can practise Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it

2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.

Model

PUT IT TOGETHER

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali. (skill: practise Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Kuandika 6.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Methali from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
